pred_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS low_reviews FROM reviews r WHERE r.review_score <= 2 AND r.review_creation_date >= DATE '2018-04-01' AND r.review_creation_date < DATE '2018-07-01'
SELECT AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_score FROM reviews r WHERE r.order_id IN (SELECT i.order_id FROM order_items i JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = i.seller_id WHERE s.seller_state = 'MG')

SELECT r.region, SUM(i.price) AS gmv FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN regions r ON r.state = c.customer_state WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-05-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-08-01' GROUP BY 1
SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM payments WHERE payment_type = 'credit_card') THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS share FROM (SELECT DISTINCT order_id FROM payments)

SELECT i.seller_id FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-02-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-02-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY SUM(i.price) DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_sellers FROM (SELECT i.seller_id FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = i.seller_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-06-02' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-09-01' AND s.seller_state = 'SP' GROUP BY 1)

SELECT p.category_en FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2019-01-01' AND p.category_en IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT AVG(date_diff('day', o.order_purchase_timestamp, o.order_delivered_customer_date)) AS avg_days FROM orders o WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2019-01-01'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM (SELECT cu.customer_unique_id FROM orders o JOIN customers cu ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY 1 HAVING MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) >= DATE '2017-01-01' AND MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) < DATE '2018-01-01' AND MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp) >= DATE '2018-01-01') t

SELECT s.seller_state, AVG(CASE WHEN CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) > CAST(o.order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE) THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS late_rate FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = i.seller_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-01-01' GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) >= 100 ORDER BY late_rate DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG(p.payment_value) AS avg_paid FROM payments p WHERE p.payment_type = 'voucher'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM (SELECT order_id FROM order_items GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) > 1)

SELECT SUM(i.price) AS gmv FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-07-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-08-01'

SELECT AVG(date_diff('day', o.order_purchase_timestamp, o.order_delivered_customer_date)) AS avg_days FROM orders o WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-03-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-04-01'

SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) > CAST(o.order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE) THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS late_rate FROM orders o WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-11-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2017-12-01'
SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT i.order_id) AS items_per_order FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'

SELECT SUM(i.price) AS gmv FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND p.category_en = 'health_beauty' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-01-01'

WITH g AS (SELECT SUM(i.price) AS gmv FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-01-01'), top AS (SELECT SUM(gmv) AS gmv FROM (SELECT i.seller_id, SUM(i.price) AS gmv FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY gmv DESC LIMIT 20)) SELECT top.gmv / g.gmv AS share FROM g, top

WITH m AS (SELECT strftime(o.order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(i.price) AS gmv FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-09-01' GROUP BY 1), g AS (SELECT month, gmv, LAG(gmv) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev FROM m) SELECT month, (gmv - prev) * 1.0 / NULLIF(prev, 0) AS growth FROM g

SELECT r.region, p.category_en, SUM(i.price) AS gmv FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN regions r ON r.state = c.customer_state WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-01-01' AND p.category_en IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region ORDER BY SUM(i.price) DESC) <= 3

SELECT SUM(i.price) AS gmv FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-01-01'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cu.customer_unique_id) AS customers FROM orders o JOIN customers cu ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2019-01-01'
SELECT customer_state FROM customers GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS reviews FROM reviews r WHERE r.review_score = 5 AND r.review_creation_date >= DATE '2017-01-01' AND r.review_creation_date < DATE '2018-01-01'

SELECT strftime(o.order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders o WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-07-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH c AS (SELECT cu.customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS n FROM orders o JOIN customers cu ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY 1) SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN n >= 2 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS repeat_share FROM c

SELECT cu.customer_state, AVG(date_diff('day', o.order_purchase_timestamp, o.order_delivered_customer_date)) AS avg_days FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN customers cu ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE i.seller_id IN (SELECT seller_id FROM sellers WHERE seller_state = 'SP') AND o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY avg_days DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(*) AS sellers FROM sellers WHERE seller_state = 'RJ'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders o WHERE o.order_status = 'canceled' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-01-01'

SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) > CAST(o.order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE) THEN 'late' ELSE 'on_time' END AS delivery, AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_score FROM reviews r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1
